chapter: Band family, war years and wrap-up
title: Enlarging the band during the war
summary: The band grew to 22 pieces and the style stayed the same.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Were there any other effects of the war years on your band? Or, anything else that you felt as a band leader that you felt changed things for you?

Well, not exactly more than me increasing the band during the war years, adding members to it. That's when I went up to 22 pieces. I had members that I actually didn't need like 3 tenor saxophones. But, nothing. I was, they kept me very busy during those years.
When you were changing the instrumentation back and forth this way, and guys were being drafted in and out, and you were adding new instruments, did this change your style at all?
No, we stayed with my own style.

It was like, I just added more members. Like, the only thing it made it just a little bigger sound, you know. Cause, like when I had Cat Anderson, I didn't need 5 trumpets - 6 with myself. But, I loved those guys. You know, and the way they could play cause they could play so well. So, I just stayed right with them.
